validation_limited: Computer Use inventory did not expose the running SDL window; real SDL/OpenGL tests supplied the GPU evidence instead.
summary: The flight, planning, control, and conjunction modules exist, but the production world does not call them. High-level commands remain queued, the app has two clocks, the satellite UI is incomplete, and the SDL and 64-satellite evidence covers a narrower workload than the approved specification.

gaps.title: 接通生产飞行控制闭环
gaps.why_it_matters: Production never calls the autopilot, execution, manual safety, or high-level command planning paths.
gaps.suggested_followup_issue: Wire queued objectives, autonomous execution, manual safety, and observable plan/failure state into the single world transition path.

gaps.title: 闭环地月转移交会与生命周期
gaps.why_it_matters: Transfer and avoidance are planning-only, while SOI changes, predictive conjunction response, and several destruction cases lack production execution evidence.
gaps.suggested_followup_issue: Execute Earth-Moon plans through the world, perform continuous SOI changes, wire conjunction avoidance, and verify all lifecycle outcomes.

gaps.title: 完成共享时钟卫星界面与图形验收
gaps.why_it_matters: The app advances separate celestial and world clocks, and the UI/SDL tests omit required satellite controls, status, mouse selection, alerts, trajectories, and destruction visuals.
gaps.suggested_followup_issue: Use the world as the sole clock, complete native Textual satellite controls and rendering, and verify them in the real SDL/GPU path.

gaps.title: 补齐净化与代表性全量验收
gaps.why_it_matters: The benchmark omits production autonomy and conjunction, all-exit sanitization is incomplete, and evidence metadata overstates delivered behavior.
gaps.suggested_followup_issue: Add the complete 64-satellite deterministic workload, sanitize startup and runtime exits, and reconcile claim evidence with actual results.

outcome_answers.answer: 六颗附带卫星和外部卫星通过严格本地 JSON 加载、历元归一化和稳定排序进入同一个世界。
outcome_answers.boundary: 该结论只覆盖数据进入世界，不代表后续自主控制已经接线。

outcome_answers.answer: 物理与资源状态已统一，但生产世界没有调用自动驾驶、共享安全、交会、SOI 和转移执行路径。
outcome_answers.boundary: 独立模块单测不能证明生产闭环。

outcome_answers.answer: 规划模块能生成部分计划，但生产世界不能完成自主任务、避碰或接管归还后的重规划。
outcome_answers.boundary: 现有证据是模块级，不是玩家可达的端到端行为。
outcome_answers.next_action: 完成 FOLLOWUP-01 和 FOLLOWUP-02，并增加生产路径测试。

outcome_answers.answer: 终端与 SDL 共用 TyPaceApp，真实 GPU 渲染已通过，但卫星面板、告警、轨迹和鼠标选星没有完整实现或验证。
outcome_answers.boundary: 通用 SDL 渲染通过不等于卫星功能验收通过。
outcome_answers.next_action: 完成 FOLLOWUP-03 并运行卫星专属真实 SDL 测试。

outcome_answers.answer: 当前 64 星 P95 测试只覆盖空闲世界更新，没有覆盖生产自动驾驶和预测交会，也没有断言重复结果一致。
outcome_answers.boundary: 15.321ms 只能代表当前较窄的空闲负载。
outcome_answers.next_action: 完成生产接线后在 FOLLOWUP-04 重跑代表性基准与确定性对照。

outcome_answers.boundary: 现有测试没有覆盖日志、启动失败、事件和所有对外输出。
outcome_answers.next_action: 在 FOLLOWUP-04 接通统一异常净化并增加集成测试。
